제품 · WHAT WE MAKE

A small range, each with a clear job

Every Mirc Glow cream contains aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid. We keep the range small on purpose, so each cream has a clear job.

Avocado Night Cream

Rich and comforting, for dry or tight-feeling skin at night. 30 g.

Glutathione Cream

With vitamin C and kojic acid, for skin that looks dull or uneven. 30 g.

Avocado Glow Cream

A light daily cream in a small 10 g jar. The easiest way to try us.

See all creams and combos in the shop, or read what each ingredient does on our ingredients page.

약속 · OUR PROMISE

What we promise, and what we don't

  • We tell you what is in the jar. Key ingredients are listed on every product page, and the full list is printed on the pack.
  • We don't promise to change your skin colour. Our creams are cosmetics. They help skin feel moisturised and look smoother, brighter and more even. Anyone promising you a new skin tone is overselling.
  • We tell you to patch test and wear sunscreen. Even when it means a slower result, because it is the honest advice.
  • We make returns simple. Unopened, sealed jars can be returned within 7 days. Damaged, wrong or expired items are replaced or refunded. Details are in our returns policy.

How ordering works

Tap "Order on WhatsApp" on any product, tell us your pincode, and pay online or choose Cash on Delivery. Shipping is free and most orders arrive in 3 to 7 days; you can follow yours on the track your order page. Salons, parlours and resellers can buy our creams by the kilo; see bulk night cream.

Learn before you buy

We write plain-English guides so you can decide for yourself. Good places to start: is avocado cream good for your skin, glutathione cream benefits, kojic acid vs glutathione, or the two-minute skin quiz. Our guides are written by our founder, Mohammed Nihal, following our editorial policy.
